purpose: Opt-in continuation through the entire approved Plan, with assistant risk assessment and delegated technical acceptance of each bounded workflow. Not a new workflow, flash, global default or background scheduler.
plan: Set mode: auto only when explicitly requested for this Plan. Omission/manual preserves per-workflow user approvals. Add auto: {maxMinutes: <explicit 1-480>, acceptance: verified-criteria}. Each job adds auto: {environment: local|isolated-test|manual, business: [exact scope IDs], resourceEffects: [{target, operation, postcondition}]}. Existing paths/resources/Work targets/criteria remain the hard ceilings. Keep all jobs, including manual checkpoints, in the full Plan. Do not enable auto for a planning-only request or migrate existing receipts silently.
delegation: Render the complete Plan with mode, budget, job effect ceilings, reserved checkpoints and technical-acceptance delegation. presentAutoPlan binds the actual presentation message, Work root and repository roots. approveAutoPlan requires an actual subsequent user reply with phase plan-auto, digest from that presentation and replyTo. Approval to add this runtime feature does not activate it in another task. Scripts bind declared provenance but cannot authenticate a user.
risk: Before every workflow, inspect current targets, tools, environment, data ownership, reversibility, blast radius and verification strength. Record assessment: {risk: low|medium|high|unknown, environment, reversible, reason, evidence: [actual inspected references], hazards: [unresolved effects or decisions]}. Only grounded low/medium, reversible, local/isolated-test work without hazards is auto-eligible. Labels cannot prove safety: localhost may proxy production; a test may send real messages or use a live DB. High/unknown risk, sensitive authorization/security changes, money/tax policy choices, real customer data, credential exposure, paid/external actions, irreversible deletion or uncertain environment must stop for the user's decision. An assistant recommendation never grants additional authority.
reserved: publish-code, deploy-release, operate-runtime, correct-data, retire-scope and update-knowledge require their own manual goal and acceptance; they are never enabled by generic auto delegation. prepare-work may prepare missing metadata but cannot import/migrate automatically. Product jobs cannot alter their own runtime. Manual jobs remain in the sequence and can hand off to later auto jobs after actual user acceptance and current proof.
execution: ASAP intake: use autoASAPWindow to show the initial candidate chain, estimated range and later checkpoint in the full Plan. Propose maxMinutes together with scope/effects in this one delegation presentation; do not ask a separate time-only question. Two workflows is an example, not a cap. A later job question/manual checkpoint must not delay earlier eligible work. On resume use autoASAPStatus with real authorization/current runs; never invent offsets or predecessor completion. Announce each concrete goal and risk assessment, then proceed immediately under valid delegation. Keep later jobs in the same Plan; waiting does not extend the deadline or authorize background scheduling.

Use nextAutoJob with the current full Plan, authorization and reconstructed current runs from the same four-file bundle. Validate that goal, approval and run files have the same planDigest. Never invent a status or restart completed work. It identifies only the next listed job; it does not run tools or spawn workers.

For that job, inspect source read-only, freeze a concrete current goal through propose and presentGoal, and announce the outcome and risk decision without an unnecessary yes/no question. authorizeAutoGoal binds the Plan authorization, current assessment and verified priorRuns; it does not fabricate a user goal receipt. At resume recheck current evidence, Work, environment, actual user revocation and remaining budget before any further effect.

Dispatch cells only through requestCell and acceptCell. Existing operators, typed output schemas, BE unit/E2E/API proof, FE design/implementation/browser UAT and Work validation remain mandatory. Exact accepted producer values feed consumers unchanged. Tool/delegation permissions remain independent; this mode does not authorize background work or additional agents.

Present actual output in this task. acceptAutoDelivery records assistant delegated-acceptance after checking current artifacts; this is technical acceptance under the user's delegation, not human UAT/sign-off. markWorkDone still validates only selected leaves with complete current proof. saveRun preserves goals, delegation/assessment, receipts, evidence roots and future jobs in the one Plan bundle.

Continue until all listed workflows and terminal criteria are proved, or a real stop condition occurs. All jobs done yields awaiting-terminal-review, not Plan done. Review each Plan completionCriterion with status: pass, an actual observation and evidence: [{jobId, cellId, criterionId}] covering every named producer. saveAutoCompletion reloads the same bundle, verifies all producers and current artifacts/Work, and records delegated Plan completion. This review is performed by the assistant without inventing human acceptance. Report the result, artifacts, tested/untested scope and any manual checkpoints directly to this task's user; never hand final output only to an observer.
stop: Stop before new effects on user revocation, budget expiry, unresolved user choice (including required design selection), unknown/high risk, missing permission/tool, scope or binding drift, stale/missing/failed evidence or invalid Work. Keep unfinished jobs and evidence. Do not rewrite auto policy, remove questions, extend the deadline, drop required stages, lower criteria or edit .claude to clear a stop. No automatic retry of failed/uncertain effects; reconcile and report, then obtain the missing authority or a bounded revised goal. Accepted past evidence remains inspectable after expiry; expiry never permits another effect.
limitations: This is a coordinator protocol backed by local lifecycle checks, not a sandbox or unattended daemon. Risk/environment statements and user message provenance still require honest host-side inspection. Hashes detect mismatched records and bytes, not fabricated observations or a malicious agent rewriting all files. Auto is allowed conditionally for bounded development/test delivery, not unrestricted execution.
